findings.title: §3's tree places `Scan.jl` under `src/CLI/`, but it lives at `src/Scan.jl`
locations: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:981 — "      Scan.jl                   `gbg scan docs|html` — the tiered engine over catalog/scans.toml" (6-space indent, nested under `CLI/`)
src/GBGCodingTools.jl:65 — `include("Scan.jl")` (listed among the top-level src/ includes, between Reflection.jl/TestHarness.jl and CLI/Ledger.jl, not among the `CLI/*.jl` includes)
findings.description: §3's repository-layout diagram indents `Scan.jl` at the same 6-space level as `Gate.jl`, `Demote.jl`, `Seed.jl`, `Recall.jl`, `Consolidate.jl`, `Audit.jl`, `Hunt.jl`, `Selftest.jl` — all of which the diagram correctly places under `CLI/` and which the module does `include("CLI/<name>.jl")`. But the actual file is `src/Scan.jl` (confirmed by `find src -type f`, which lists it as a sibling of `TreeHash.jl`, `HtmlWalker.jl`, `Reflection.jl`, `Witnesses.jl`, `TestHarness.jl`, `DocLints.jl`) and the module includes it as `include("Scan.jl")`, not `include("CLI/Scan.jl")`. A reader locating the scan engine by this diagram would look in the wrong directory.
findings.resolution_hint: Move the `Scan.jl` line out from under `CLI/` in §3's tree to the 4-space level, alongside `TreeHash.jl`/`HtmlWalker.jl`/`DocLints.jl`/`TestHarness.jl`/`Reflection.jl`/`Witnesses.jl`.

findings.title: D9 cites `src/Scans/ProseShape.jl`, but the file is `src/Scans/prose_shape.jl`
locations: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:531-533 — "The prose-shape ratchet is a scan like any other (`src/Scans/ProseShape.jl`, `catalog/scans.toml` entry `SCAN.PROSE_SHAPE`)…"

src/Scans/ (directory listing) — the file is `prose_shape.jl`, and every other scan file in the directory (`abutting_spans.jl`, `ai_banner.jl`, `field_docs.jl`, …) is likewise lower_snake_case, never PascalCase
findings.description: Every scan implementation file under `src/Scans/` is named in lower_snake_case matching its scan function (e.g. `prose_shape.jl`, `ai_banner.jl`, `field_docs.jl`); none use PascalCase. D9's parenthetical names the file `ProseShape.jl`, which does not exist — the actual path is `src/Scans/prose_shape.jl`. This is the one file-path citation in the document that departs from the project's own (and the document's own, elsewhere — e.g. §3's `Scans/<ScanId>.jl`, §12.B's scan table) convention of naming scan files by their lower_snake_case function name.
